title: Going to the Beach
description: A boy spends a summer day at the beach with his parents.
instructions: Read the text about a day at the beach, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: In July, Peter went to the beach with his parents. They went by car. The trip took two hours.
The sea was blue and the sand was hot. Peter swam in the sea with his dad. His mum sat under a big umbrella and read a book.
Later, Peter built a sandcastle. He found some pretty shells and put them on it. In the evening, they ate fish at a small restaurant near the sea.
After dinner, they walked on the beach. The sun went down and the sky was orange and pink. Peter took a photo of it with his mum's phone. The water was cold on his feet.
Then Peter saw a small crab on the sand. It was red and it walked sideways. Peter laughed. His dad said, 'Do not touch it. It can hurt your fingers.' So Peter only looked at it.
At nine o'clock, they drove home. Peter was very tired. He slept in the car for most of the trip. His dad drove and his mum sang quietly with the radio.
The next day, Peter put his shells in a glass jar on his desk. He showed the photo of the sky to his grandma. 'It was the best day of the summer,' he said. He wants to go back to the beach next year.
